messages.text: This room provides regional species observations, with a focus on GBIF occurrence searches, fixed limits of 300 per page, and pagination. You will receive species, observation times, coordinate precision, datasets, and record counts. When someone writes in, I will process their request for regional species data, adhering to taxon key, bbox, and date range parameters. As there are no incoming messages yet, I will immediately deliver a sample observation: Species: *Homo sapiens*, Observation Time: 2023-10-27T10:30:00Z, Coordinate Precision: 100m, Dataset: Personal Observation, Record Count: 1.

This room is for sharing regional species observations. When you provide a taxon key, bounding box, and date range, I can help you search GBIF occurrence data with a limit of 300 results per page and deliver details on species, observation time, coordinate precision, datasets, and record counts. I will not be able to fulfill requests outside of this scope.
